mapper.insert: insert into `order` (order_id, user_id, merchant_id, rider_id, voucher_connection_id, meal_id, meal_name, meal_price, meal_description, meal_show_image_addr, meal_content, meal_type, number, delivery_address, delivery_lon, delivery_lat, origin_cost, discount_cost, rider_cost, total_cost) values(#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{riderId}, #{voucherConnectionId}, #{mealId}, #{mealName}, #{mealPrice}, #{mealDescription}, #{mealShowImageAddr}, #{mealContent}, #{mealType}, #{number}, #{deliveryAddress}, #{deliveryLon}, #{deliveryLat}, #{originCost}, #{discountCost}, #{riderCost}, #{totalCost});
mapper.select: select order_id, user_id, merchant_id, rider_id, voucher_connection_id, meal_id, meal_name, meal_price, meal_show_image_addr, number, delivery_address, total_cost, state_now, is_refund, is_lock, is_ack, is_complete from `order` where (user_id=#{tokenId} or merchant_id=#{tokenId} or rider_id=#{tokenId}) and state_now > 0 order by order_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select order_id, user_id, merchant_id, rider_id, voucher_connection_id, meal_id, meal_name, meal_price, meal_show_image_addr, number, delivery_address, total_cost, state_now, is_refund, is_lock, is_ack, is_complete from `order` where (user_id=#{tokenId} or merchant_id=#{tokenId} or rider_id=#{tokenId}) and state_now=#{state} order by order_id desc limit #{start},#{need}
